nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bạn bè · bài tự soạn
kind: Tin nhắn thoại xin lỗi vì lỡ hẹn
L: Hi Nina, it's Ken. I'm really sorry about last night.
I know we planned to see that new movie together, but I got stuck at work.
My boss asked me to finish a report, and I completely lost track of time.
By the time I looked at my phone, it was almost ten o'clock.
I should have called you, and I feel terrible about it.
Anyway, can I make it up to you?
How about dinner on Friday? My treat.
We can go to that noodle place you like, and then catch the late show.
Call me back when you get this, okay? Talk soon!

exq.q: Why did Ken miss the movie?
exq.why: “I got stuck at work” = bị kẹt ở chỗ làm.

exq.q: What does Ken want to do on Friday?
exq.why: “How about dinner on Friday? My treat.” = mời đi ăn tối thứ Sáu.

exq.q: What does Ken ask Nina to do?
exq.why: “Call me back when you get this.”

exq.q: How does Ken feel about missing the movie?
exq.why: “I feel terrible about it” = thấy áy náy.
